metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a Python 3.11+ RS274/NGC G-code simulator CLI under `output/`, runnable as `python output/main.py ...` (`output/main.py:1`).

- Supports required flags: `--input`, `--output`, optional `--tool-table`, `--parameter-input/--parameter-output`, `--block-delete`, `--carousel-slots`, `--probe-box/--probe-tool`, and `--trace-output` with exactly one stepping mode (`output/main.py:1`).
- Core execution engine (modal state, motion, canned cycles, probing, tool/parameter handling, program-end resets) is in `output/simulator.py:1`.
- Trace file generation (initial snapshot + delta entries) is in `output/trace.py:1`, with correct handling of multiple same-timestamp state transitions (e.g. G84 spindle reversals).
- Fixed serialization so G20/G21 converts only linear axes (X/Y/Z); rotary axes (A/B/C) remain degrees (`output/serialize.py:1`).

If you want, I can add a small `README` under `output/` describing supported RS274 features and a couple example invocations.
